## Setup 

```{r setup, error=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, include=TRUE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales) 
library(knitr)
df = read.csv("C:/Users/Azer/OneDrive/Desktop/R Devlab/archive/sales_data_sample.csv", fileEncoding = "latin1")
```

## Task 1


```{r task1, error=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, include=TRUE}
df_clean = df
```
## Task 2


```{r task2, error=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, include=TRUE}
df_clean$ORDERDATE = as.Date(df_clean$ORDERDATE, format = "%m/%d/%Y %H:%M")
```

## Task 3


```{r task3, error=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, include=TRUE}
colSums(df_clean == "", na.rm = TRUE)
```

## Task 4


```{r task4, error=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, include=TRUE}
df_clean$TERRITORY[is.na(df_clean$TERRITORY)] = "Unknown"
```


## Task 5


```{r task5, error=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, include=TRUE}
summary(df_clean[, c("QUANTITYORDERED", "PRICEEACH", "SALES", "MSRP")])
table(df_clean$STATUS)
table(df_clean$YEAR_ID)
sort(table(df_clean$PRODUCTLINE), decreasing = TRUE)
```


## Task 6


```{r task6, error=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, include=TRUE}
ggplot(df_clean, aes(x = SALES)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(
    title = "Satış məbləğlərinin paylanması",
    x = "Satış məbləği",
    y = "Satış sətirlərinin sayı"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```


## Task 7


```{r task7, error=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, include=TRUE}
il_tehlili = df_clean %>%
  group_by(YEAR_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    Satis_setirlerinin_sayi = n(),
    Umumi_satis = sum(SALES, na.rm = TRUE),
    Orta_satis = mean(SALES, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

il_tehlili
```


## Task 8


```{r task8, error=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, include=TRUE}

    aes(label = Satis_setirlerinin_sayi),

  ) +

```


## Task 9



## Task 10


```{r task10, error=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, include=TRUE}
mehsul_tehlili = df_clean %>%
  group_by(PRODUCTLINE) %>%
  summarise(
    Satis_setirlerinin_sayi = n(),
    Umumi_satis = sum(SALES, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Satis_setirlerinin_sayi))

mehsul_tehlili
```


## Task 11


```{r task11, error=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, include=TRUE}
ggplot(mehsul_tehlili,
       aes(x = reorder(PRODUCTLINE, Satis_setirlerinin_sayi),
           y = Satis_setirlerinin_sayi)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = Satis_setirlerinin_sayi),
    hjust = -0.2,
    size = 4
  ) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1100),
    breaks = seq(0, 1000, 250),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Məhsul xətləri üzrə satış sətirlərinin sayı",
    x = "Məhsul xətti",
    y = "Satış sətirlərinin sayı"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(10, 35, 10, 10)
  )
```

## Task 16

```{r task16, error=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, include=TRUE}
Q1 = quantile(df_clean$SALES, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
Q3 = quantile(df_clean$SALES, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)

IQR_deyeri = IQR(df_clean$SALES, na.rm = TRUE)

alt_serhed = Q1 - 1.5 * IQR_deyeri
ust_serhed = Q3 + 1.5 * IQR_deyeri

c(
  Q1 = Q1,
  Q3 = Q3,
  IQR = IQR_deyeri,
  Alt_serhed = alt_serhed,
  Ust_serhed = ust_serhed
)
```


## Task 17
```{r task17, error=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, include=TRUE}
kənar_satışlar = df_clean %>%
  filter(SALES < alt_serhed | SALES > ust_serhed)

nrow(kənar_satışlar)
```

## Task 24
```{r task24, error=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, include=TRUE}
bos_metn_tehlili = data.frame(
  Sutun = names(df_clean),
  Bos_metn_sayi = sapply(df_clean, function(x) {
    if (is.character(x)) {
      sum(trimws(x) == "", na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      0
    }
  })
)
```

## Task 31
```{r task31, error=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, include=TRUE}
umumi_satis = sum(df_clean$SALES, na.rm = TRUE)

orta_satis = mean(df_clean$SALES, na.rm = TRUE)

median_satis = median(df_clean$SALES, na.rm = TRUE)

shipped_faizi = mean(df_clean$STATUS == "Shipped", na.rm = TRUE) * 100

cat("Ümumi satış məbləği:", round(umumi_satis, 2), "\n")
cat("Orta satış məbləği:", round(orta_satis, 2), "\n")
cat("Median satış məbləği:", round(median_satis, 2), "\n")
cat("Shipped statusunun satış sətirlərində payı:", round(shipped_faizi, 2), "%\n")
```
